description.p: Undavi listens to your system audio, or to a single app, and draws it as a live spectrum, alongside the album art, playback controls and time-synced lyrics of the track that is playing.

ul.li: Bars, a ring around the album cover, or a smooth wave, in many colors
Time-synced lyrics from LRCLIB, word by word when available
Backgrounds of blurred album art or soft ambient color
Fine tuning, presets, and full keyboard navigation

description.p: One settings window with a live preview, search and presets for every section, custom visualizer and background shaders, and update checks.
